title: add swords
description: This mod adds some new swords.
body:
This mod is add three swords. I will introduce of all swords.



> - Wind sword

> You can send monsters flying upwards with this sword. You can make a diamond sword and a wind charge with craft table.

- Fire sword

> You can burn monsters with this sword. You can make a diamond sword and a blaze rod with craft table.

- Wind and Fire sword

> You can send monsters moreflying upwards with this sword than Wind sword. If you want to burn monsters, you can burn monsters within 10 blocks by right-clicking on them. You can make a Wind sword and a Fire sword with craft table.
